name: ZScoreStandardizeNode
label: Z-Score Standardize
description: Standardizes one or more numeric columns to have zero mean and unit variance (sample standard deviation) using each column's global statistics.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: DataTable
fields.label: Data Table
fields.description: The data table containing the numeric columns to standardize.

fields.name: ColumnsToStandardize
fields.label: Columns To Standardize
fields.description: Comma-separated numeric column names to standardize.

fields.name: StandardizedDataTable
fields.label: Standardized Data Table
fields.description: The resulting data table with standardized columns.
